title: Some Advice
subtitle: from people who have no idea who you are

lines.text: It's always the fear of a thing.
It was never as difficult as you were afraid it would be.
Be careful what movies you sneak into, kids.
Eat a lot, a lot of cruciferous vegetables.
You could just drink out of the tap.
Let's go for a drink. Let's do it. Let's hang out.
Come on, don't be such an old lady. Everything's cool.
Staring out a window, thinking the life you should be living is out there somewhere, but not being willing to open the door and go get it.
There's always a way. Okay, it may not be the best way.
You have to expect failure, and you have to expect to learn from that failure.
Sounds like something you should be telling your psychiatrist.
